_comment: Safety list. The game reads this on launch; if the running version is named in 'blocked' it shows an update prompt instead of starting — used only for a build that crashes on launch, and only once a fixed build is out. An EMPTY 'blocked' list is the normal, healthy state. Lives at the ROOT of p3ohyes/gloomstone-releases (main); the app fetches it from raw.githubusercontent.com.
_rules: ONLY add a version AFTER a fixed version is published. Blocking with no fix available strands players with nothing to update to.
Exact version strings. No ranges — a range typo could take out every build at once.
Remove entries once nobody is realistically still on them; the list is not a changelog.
The app FAILS OPEN: if this file is missing, unreachable or malformed, the game launches normally.
